text: Throughout the pandemic, not-for-profit organizations, grassroots and resident-led groups have assumed vital leadership roles in responding to the urgent and often exacerbated needs of Torontonians who are vulnerable. As a key funder of groups and organizations across Toronto, Social Development, Finance and Administration provided over $65 million in 2020 and 2021 to support the social service sector through ongoing and emergency grant programs. In responding to the emerging situation brought forth by the pandemic, Social Development, Finance and Administration prioritized providing stable support for long-term funded groups while also targeting new and enhanced investments to address the City's reconciliation and equity goals and commitments to support already marginalized communities experiencing disproportionate impacts from the pandemic.
